parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const norm=v=>{let d=String(v||'').replace(/\D/g,'');if(d.length===10||d.length===11)d='55'+d;return d};const s=$getWorkflowStaticData('global');s.gota={target:8,found:[],keys:[],phones:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>norm(r.phone||r._phoneNormalized)).filter(Boolean))],companies:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>String(r.company_name||'').trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))]};const seg=['salão de beleza','barbearia','clínica de estética','pizzaria','restaurante','pet shop','oficina mecânica','clínica odontológica'];const area=['Pompeia','Perdizes','Mooca','Tatuapé','Vila Mariana','Ipiranga','Santana','Lapa','Saúde','Penha','Vila Prudente','Pinheiros'];const day=Math.floor(Date.now()/86400000);return Array.from({length:12},(_,i)=>({json:{query:`${seg[(day+i)%seg.length]} em ${area[(day*3+i*5)%area.length]}, São Paulo - SP`,segment:seg[(day+i)%seg.length],area:area[(day*3+i*5)%area.length]}}));
